cover: Map your workbook before you replace it

slides.title: List every tab and formula
slides.body: Write down each tab, formula, macro and workaround. Together they describe how the business works.

slides.title: Walk a normal day and a hard one
slides.body: Ask the person who knows the workbook to show you both. Record the exceptions as well as the formulas.

slides.title: Agree what each record means
slides.body: What's an order, a tenant, a repair? Which links between them must stay intact?

slides.title: Find the duplicates
slides.body: Where does the same customer appear twice, and which copy is right? Decide how to fix each before import.

slides.title: Plan the check
slides.body: Agree how staff will check the imported data, and run both side by side until the team trusts the new system.

slides.title: Or keep the sheet
slides.body: If one person owns it, it's for analysis, or the process changes weekly, a spreadsheet is still the right tool.
